verdict.rationale: NVIDIA ships official SDKs for building on its GPUs. The CUDA docs describe runtime and driver APIs, math libraries, compiler/PTX interfaces, and debugging/profiling tools for GPU-accelerated applications. NeMo Framework, the JAX Toolbox, NIM, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit included on DGX B200 add higher-level official frameworks for training and deploying models. Missing for 10: no evidence explicitly tying these SDKs to B200/Blackwell support, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of developers building against them on B200.
